name: @openlife-au/workspace
description: Open Life Data Standards (AU) — vendor-neutral contracts for Australian life insurance

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:quoting && npm run bundle:policy && npm run bundle:requirements && npm run bundle:commissions
scripts.bundle:quoting: redocly bundle domains/quoting/openapi.yaml -o dist/quoting/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains/quoting/openapi.yaml -o dist/quoting/openapi.json && node scripts/mark-dist-version.mjs quoting
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run versions && npm run dist:check && npm run examples && npm run rejections && npm run postman:check && npm run provenance
scripts.codegen: for l in typescript python java ruby go csharp rust; do npm run codegen:$l || exit 1; done
scripts.bundle:policy: redocly bundle domains/policy/openapi.yaml -o dist/policy/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains/policy/openapi.yaml -o dist/policy/openapi.json && node scripts/mark-dist-version.mjs policy
scripts.postman:check: npm run postman && git diff --exit-code -- postman/ || (echo '' && echo '✗ postman/ was stale. It has just been regenerated above — review and commit it.' && exit 1)
scripts.dist:check: npm run bundle && git diff --exit-code -- dist/ || (echo '' && echo '✗ dist/ was stale. It has just been rebuilt above — review and commit it.' && exit 1)
scripts.bundle:requirements: redocly bundle domains/requirements/openapi.yaml -o dist/requirements/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains/requirements/openapi.yaml -o dist/requirements/openapi.json && node scripts/mark-dist-version.mjs requirements
scripts.bundle:commissions: redocly bundle domains/commissions/openapi.yaml -o dist/commissions/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains/commissions/openapi.yaml -o dist/commissions/openapi.json && node scripts/mark-dist-version.mjs commissions
